<style id="acf-sw-slim-sticky-nav-style-2-inline-css">

    }

    }

    }

    .title .sw19s-std-wrap {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
    }

        color: #111111;
        transition: all .2s ease-in-out;
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 700;
    }

    &.sw19-is-sticky.classic .title p {
        color: #fff;
    }

    }

    }

        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .links {
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-end;
    }

    .links a {
        transition: all .4s ease-in-out;
        color: #111111;
        text-decoration: none;

        font-weight: 300;
        display: inline-block;
        margin-right: 30px;
        padding-bottom: 2px;

    }
